pollo-curry.name: Curry Chicken
pollo-curry.description: Delicious chicken with aromatic spices and coconut milk. A quick and healthy recipe with high protein content.

step1.title: Cut chicken into medium cubes
step1.description: Cut chicken breast into approximately 2-3 cm cubes. Make sure all pieces are similar in size for even cooking.

step2.title: Heat oil in a large pan
step2.description: Heat 2 tablespoons of coconut oil or olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.

step3.title: Sear the chicken
step3.description: Add chicken cubes to the hot pan and sear on all sides until golden brown, approximately 5-6 minutes.
step3.tip: Don't move the chicken constantly, let it sear well to keep it juicy inside.

step4.title: Add curry and coconut milk
step4.description: Sprinkle curry powder over the chicken, mix well and add coconut milk. Reduce heat to medium and cook for 8-10 minutes.
step4.tip: Stir occasionally to prevent sticking to the bottom.

step5.title: Serve hot
step5.description: Once chicken is fully cooked and sauce has thickened slightly, serve hot with basmati rice or steamed vegetables.

pollo-curry.history1: Curry is a spice blend originating from the Indian subcontinent, combining turmeric, coriander, cumin and other aromatic spices. Turmeric, the main ingredient in curry, contains curcumin, a powerful natural anti-inflammatory. When combined with coconut milk and chicken, we get a dish rich in proteins and healthy fats.
pollo-curry.seo-title: Curry Chicken - Easy and Healthy Recipe with Coconut Milk
pollo-curry.seo-description: Curry chicken recipe with coconut milk. High in protein, low in carbs and ready in 25 minutes. Perfect for a quick and nutritious meal.
